response_text:
Yes. DonorDock includes built-in online giving.

Key points from DonorDock’s own materials:

- **Giving Pages / Online Giving Pages**  
  - You can create unlimited branded donation pages and forms for campaigns, events, sponsorships, memberships, and general donations.  
  - Gifts made through these pages are **automatically created in DonorDock** and tied to donor records.  
  - You can configure amounts, frequencies (one-time or recurring), designations, and gift types (Donation, Event Ticket, Membership).  
  - Pages can be shared by direct link, QR code, text-to-donate, or embedded on your website.  
  - Supports tracking/segmentation (contact badges, gift tags, marketing lists) for follow-up and automation.

- **Payment processing & integrations**  
  - Uses **Stripe Connect** (recommended to access all features), plus support for **PayPal**.  
  - Integrates with **Chariot** for DAF (Donor-Advised Fund) giving.  
  - Integrates with **Double the Donation** for employer matching gifts.

- **Fees**  
  - DonorDock **does not charge mandatory platform fees** on online gifts.  
  - Donors can optionally choose to cover a **5% + $0.30** “donor-funded platform fee,” which helps cover both processing and DonorDock costs.  
  - If the donor does not cover fees, your organization pays only the normal **Stripe processing fees**, and **no DonorDock platform fee**.

- **Related features**  
  - Recurring gifts management and tracking.  
  - Automated receipts and follow-up emails.  
  - Donor profiles and campaign progress update instantly.

So yes—DonorDock provides a full online giving solution built into its CRM, centered around customizable Giving Pages.
